use_cases: Animated headlines for landing pages and marketing sections
Character-by-character text reveal effects on page load
Interactive title animations for websites and applications
Rolling text effects for product names or promotional banners
Visual emphasis animations for call-to-action text elements
ai_summary: A 3D text animation utility that creates a rolling or flipping effect on each character of a string using CSS perspective and rotateX transforms. Part of the motion-primitives library, this component is commonly used for animated headlines, text reveals, and marketing content where visual character-by-character transitions add engagement and visual interest.
